headline_marked: PM Tarique Rahman [[orders nationwide support for flood-affected people]]
headline: PM Tarique Rahman orders nationwide support for flood-affected people
summary: The Prime Minister has directed administration and party leaders to ensure food, clean water, and medical services for those hit by heavy rains and floods.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has issued necessary directives to the administration and party leaders to stand by people affected by heavy rainfall and floods across the country.
On Friday, the PM spoke with Deputy Commissioners (DC), Superintendents of Police (SP), and Civil Surgeons of various flood-hit districts to assess the overall situation.
He also coordinated with ministers and secretaries of the Ministry of Disaster Management and Relief and other relevant ministries to make rescue, relief, and rehabilitation efforts more effective.
State Minister for Power and Energy, Oninda Islam Amit, has been tasked with coordinating overall activities including rescue and medical services in the flood-affected districts.
The Prime Minister is scheduled to visit Chattogram on Saturday, accompanied by State Minister for Relief, M. Iqbal Hossain, and other officials to manage the situation.
Special attention has been directed toward women and children, particularly pregnant women, to ensure they receive necessary care during this crisis.
Law enforcement agencies have been ordered to remain highly alert to prevent any criminal activities, such as theft or robbery, taking advantage of the flood situation.
Officials reported that floodwaters have begun to recede in some areas, though the situation continues to be monitored closely.
caption:
Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has ordered a nationwide mobilization of administration and party leaders to support flood victims.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has issued necessary directives to the administration and party leaders to stand by people affected by heavy rainfall and floods across the country.

On Friday, the PM spoke with Deputy Commissioners (DC), Superintendents of Police (SP), and Civil Surgeons of various flood-hit districts to assess the overall situation.

He also coordinated with ministers and secretaries of the Ministry of Disaster Management and Relief and other relevant ministries to make rescue, relief, and rehabilitation efforts more effective.

State Minister for Power and Energy, Oninda Islam Amit, has been tasked with coordinating overall activities including rescue and medical services in the flood-affected districts.

The Prime Minister is scheduled to visit Chattogram on Saturday, accompanied by State Minister for Relief, M. Iqbal Hossain, and other officials to manage the situation.

Special attention has been directed toward women and children, particularly pregnant women, to ensure they receive necessary care during this crisis.

Law enforcement agencies have been ordered to remain highly alert to prevent any criminal activities, such as theft or robbery, taking advantage of the flood situation.

Officials reported that floodwaters have begun to recede in some areas, though the situation continues to be monitored closely.

headline_marked: Man jailed as [[14-year-old girl in Faridpur children's home found pregnant]]
headline: Man jailed as 14-year-old girl in Faridpur children's home found pregnant
summary: A 54-year-old tailor was arrested for allegedly raping a resident of a government-run home; five officials have been suspended for negligence.
details: A Faridpur court has sent a 54-year-old man to jail in connection with the rape of a 14-year-old girl living at a government-run children's home in the Tepakhola area.
The victim, a class-6 student, is currently more than 27 weeks pregnant. Medical examinations on July 6 revealed the pregnancy after she developed physical complications.
The accused, Md Wahid Sheikh, a local tailor, allegedly lured the girl with chocolates and raped her on multiple occasions starting from January 5.
Following the discovery, the superintendent of the children's home filed a case with the Faridpur Kotwali Police Station on July 6.
The Department of Social Services has suspended five officials and employees of the home, including the Assistant Superintendent and matron-nurse, for alleged negligence.
The girl has since been transferred to a government shelter for women, children, and adolescent girls under the Department of Social Services for her safety and care.
caption:
A 14-year-old girl in a government-run children's home was found to be 27 weeks pregnant after being raped by a local tailor.

A Faridpur court has sent a 54-year-old man to jail in connection with the rape of a 14-year-old girl living at a government-run children's home in the Tepakhola area.

The victim, a class-6 student, is currently more than 27 weeks pregnant. Medical examinations on July 6 revealed the pregnancy after she developed physical complications.

The accused, Md Wahid Sheikh, a local tailor, allegedly lured the girl with chocolates and raped her on multiple occasions starting from January 5.

Following the discovery, the superintendent of the children's home filed a case with the Faridpur Kotwali Police Station on July 6.

The Department of Social Services has suspended five officials and employees of the home, including the Assistant Superintendent and matron-nurse, for alleged negligence.

The girl has since been transferred to a government shelter for women, children, and adolescent girls under the Department of Social Services for her safety and care.
